package: R9-E1/E2 prototype failure-cause diagnostics (private plan 2026-11-19 section 6.3)
exposure_status: follow-up diagnosis on already-exposed source development data (GSE149614 outer LOPO; every donor was seen during v1 development). Not an independent validation. GSE151530 / A4 v2 results are not read by this package.

source_contract.representation: v1 target-excluded fold representation <test>__excl_<target>.npz (read-only), identical to a2_main_v1
source_contract.training_cells: r9tasks.select(obs, cond, test, seed) - identical to a2_main_v1 (design and n_train asserted against the v1 run JSON)
source_contract.loss: L_donor,class for every arm; 300 Adam steps, lr 0.02 (v1 settings)

E1_arms.P1_current: 1 component/class, learnable diagonal variance (v1 ProtoHead) - refit of v1 P1_donor
E1_arms.P3_current: 3 components/class (k-means init), learnable diagonal variance - refit of v1 A10
E1_arms.P1_fixedvar: 1 component/class, initial shrunk diagonal variance frozen (excluded from the optimizer)
E1_arms.P3_fixedvar: 3 components/class, each component's initial shrunk diagonal variance frozen
E1_arms.P3_pooledvar: 3 components/class, every component uses the frozen class-level variance vector of P1_fixedvar
E1_arms.sharing: same-K arms share initial membership, means and mixture weights; P3_pooledvar variance == P1_fixedvar class variance

E2_arms.A11_refit: donor-supported greedy allocation to K=3C with the v1 fixed fallback (refit of v1 A11; current variance)
E2_arms.supported_stop: the same greedy sequence stopped at the first step without an admissible candidate (K*); K* is set in the source fold only
E2_arms.matched_kstar: per-class k-means partition with the same per-class component counts as supported_stop (current variance)
E2_arms.kstar_equals_K: when no fallback occurs supported_stop == A11_refit allocation and matched_kstar has 3/class; fits are still run (cheap) and flagged kstar_eq_K
E2_arms.logging: every examined candidate per step: support of both children, mean held-out gain, fraction positive, n evaluable donors, rejection_reason
E2_arms.variance_rule: current (learnable) variance is primary for E2
E2_arms.conditional_variance_rerun: ONLY if E1 contrast (b) P3_current-P3_fixedvar has simultaneous CI upper < 0 and mean <= -0.01 -> refit the three E2 arms with frozen per-component variance; ONLY if E1 contrast (c) P3_fixedvar-P3_pooledvar has simultaneous CI upper < 0 and mean <= -0.01 -> refit them with pooled class variance. Uses the saved E2 memberships; otherwise record as not run.

baselines: saved a2_main_v1 predictions for the same 90 keys: LR_class, LR_donor, MLP_donor (strong baselines) and P1_donor, A10, A11 (v1 references); refit arms are also compared with the saved v1 predictions (replay agreement reported)

metrics.primary: target-label AUPRC on the held-out source donor (NA, never 0, when the donor has <10 target positives; v1 a2_eval rule)
metrics.secondary: target recall, target false positives, all-cell NLL; diagnostics: variance-floor fraction, mean/max |log-variance change|, component ESS, max donor share, train weighted CE, held-out class-balanced CE, CE gap, K*, fallback step and rejection reasons

aggregation: seeds averaged within (target, donor); primary summary = target-equally-weighted donor vector (mean over the targets evaluable for that donor; identical for both arms of a contrast); donor paired bootstrap 10,000 resamples (seed 0). Per-target contrasts are secondary.

E1.a: P3_pooledvar - P1_fixedvar (K effect with the class covariance fixed)
E1.c: P3_fixedvar - P3_pooledvar (per-component initial variance estimate effect)

primary_contrasts.not_pure_K_effect: P3_fixedvar - P1_fixedvar mixes K and per-component variance; reported as secondary only

multiplicity: within each family of 3: Bonferroni-simultaneous 98.333% percentile bootstrap CI decides 'established'; 95% CI also reported
practical_threshold_note: plan section 2.3 proposal for R9; fixed here before any run; not a v1 threshold

decision_categories.equivalent_within_margin: 90% percentile donor-bootstrap CI entirely inside [-0.01, +0.01] (pre-set equivalence margin)
decision_categories.not_established: simultaneous CI contains 0 and the equivalence condition is not met

decision_rules_from_plan.E1: fixedvar-only improvement -> stabilising variance optimisation is the first follow-up; K=1 strong under every variance condition -> low need for multiple components at this N/D; pooledvar favourable -> sparse-component variance estimation/shrinkage is the follow-up question; uncertain -> cause not identified (do not infer a bigger encoder).
decision_rules_from_plan.E2: supported_stop > A11 alone is not a causal fallback effect; matched_kstar also improving -> consistent with capacity reduction; supported_stop > matched_kstar -> donor-supported partition value at equal capacity is a follow-up question.
decision_rules_from_plan.adoption: beating P1/A10/A11 is a cause-analysis result, not a win over LR/MLP; adoption of any new arm requires its effect vs the strong baselines with uncertainty and cost and is not decided here.

cost_rule: pilot = 1 (test donor, seed) x 3 targets; measure CPU time/memory; run all 90 only if the estimate fits ~24 h wall under the track cap (14 concurrent jobs, CPU only)
